description:
Every feature is free. There are no subscriptions, premium tiers, trip limits, or time limits.

Whether you drive 5 miles or 50,000 miles per year, you get the complete experience—because accurate mileage tracking should not require another monthly bill.

Meet your ultimate mileage companion; automatically track every drive and maximize reimbursements or tax deductions with ease.

No account. No subscription. No in-app purchases. Just simple mileage tracking with privacy built in.

AUTOMATIC TRIP TRACKING
Smart GPS detection begins logging when you start driving and stops when your trip ends—no need to press Start or Stop.

Customize automatic tracking to fit your needs:

Choose the trigger speed for auto-start
Adjust the stop delay
Set a minimum distance to ignore very short trips
FOLLOW YOUR TRIP WHILE YOU DRIVE
A Live Activity on your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island displays your live distance and a running timer. You can confirm that your drive is being recorded without opening the app.

QUICK CATEGORIZATION AND NOTES
Classify trips with a simple swipe:

Swipe left for Business
Swipe right for Personal
Long-press for Medical, Charity, or Other
You can also categorize a trip directly from the Trip Ended notification without unlocking your phone.

Automatically categorize drives based on your work hours, or save frequent destinations as Favorite Locations—such as “Home,” “Office,” or “Client”—with their own assigned categories. Add notes or a business purpose to any trip.

releaseNotes:
IRS mid-year bump: business miles are 76¢ from July 1 (was 72.5¢). 
Medical rates updated. Each trip grabs the rate for its date automatically.
Missed Trip Recovery (optional, in Settings): if iOS killed the app mid-drive, the trip gets rebuilt from your recorded departure and arrival. 
Fixed: after a background restart, trip detection could silently stop working until you reopened the app. No more. Short drives also caught more reliably now.
Year-End Tax Package now includes an audit-defense section.
Share a YTD deduction card from Reports.
